comment: The two harmonic shift jacks are crossed over in the code: the X jack moves the drawing along the harmonics and the Y jack raises and lowers the levels, the opposite way round to every other grid on the plugin. The maker did that on purpose — BallOfConfusion.cpp:587 carries the comment “Axis are reversed” — because this grid alone is drawn as vertical bars, so its harmonics run across the screen where the others run down it. Read against the panel the two jacks are right; read against the shared grid code they look swapped. Three quantize parameters and two outputs are declared with no widget on the panel, so they can never be clicked and are left untagged.
